title: Comic build
description: Build one Comic B issue from scratch with the comic build framework (scripts/comics/README.md): write and check the story, Matt approves the words, then every scene is planned, drawn through Codex lanes, reviewed at full size, layered, lettered, scored, registered, bound and frame-reviewed on 8789, one scene at a time; Matt accepts the issue; voices follow as their own paid step.

inputs.name: brief
inputs.label: Story brief from Matt (what must change)

nodes.label: Write and check the story
nodes.note: Stage story of the comic-build workflow: writer, four checks, cold read, review sheet in wiki/comics-library/records/<slug>-build-<build>/story-review.md.

nodes.label: Approve the words
nodes.note: Read story-review.md and the issue in /m/comics. Approve freezes every word; later steps move balloons but never change text. Reject with what to change; then start a new run of this workflow with that note as the brief (the engine does not loop back).

nodes.label: Build every scene
nodes.note: Stage scenes: one scene at a time; Codex lanes, full-size reviews, planes cut from masters, lettering from measured faces, sound, one registration per scene, binding, frames on 8789 reviewed frame by frame. Stops after one correction per defect and reports the rest.

nodes.label: Accept the issue
nodes.note: Play /comics/<slug>/ on 8789 on desktop and phone. Accept, or reject with the scene and box ids that fail; each goes back through the scene step as a new attempt in the same ledger. Voices come after acceptance: approve each line in the issue review in /m/comics and generate it there (comics-generate-speech, one balloon at a time, paid).
